changeSet.author: grushton

preConditions.onFailMessage: dataset_property must have 1 timestamp or timestamptz column(s): create_date. Compare the deployed schema with the changesets before you deploy.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'dataset_property' AND column_name IN ('create_date') AND data_type IN ('timestamp without time zone', 'timestamp with time zone')

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE dataset_property ALTER COLUMN create_date TYPE timestamp with time zone

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE dataset_property ALTER COLUMN create_date TYPE timestamp without time zone
